verses.sloka: कृतबुद्धिं निवासाय तत्रैव स मुनिस्तदा ।भरतं कैकयीपुत्रमातिथ्येन न्यमन्त्रयत् ॥ २.९१.१॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtabuddhiṁ nivāsāya tatraiva sa munistadā ।bharataṁ kaikayīputramātithyena nyamantrayat ॥ 2.91.1॥

translations.english: With the decision of Bharata, son of Kaikeyi, to stay there for the night, sage Bharadwaja extended to him all hospitality.
translations.hindi: अयोध्याकाण्ड का सत्तांसीवाँ सग समाप्त हुआ ॥ अष्टाशीतितमः सग; —— # १-- तच्छ त्या निपुणंः सर्वे भरतः सह मन्त्रिभिः । इङ्शुदीमूलमागम्य रामशय्यामवेच्य ताम्‌

verses.sloka: अब्रवीद्भरतस्त्वेनं नन्विदं भवता कृतम् ।पाद्यमर्घ्यं तथातिथ्यं वने यदुपपद्यते ॥ २.९१.२॥
verses.transliteration: abravīdbharatastvenaṁ nanvidaṁ bhavatā kṛtam ।pādyamarghyaṁ tathātithyaṁ vane yadupapadyate ॥ 2.91.2॥

translations.english: Bharata said to Bharadwaja, You have already extended the hospitality in offering water for washing the feet with and of arghya befitting a guest as available in the forest.
translations.hindi: और अपनी माताओं से बोले कि, महात्मा राम्‌ ने उस रात) इसी टृणशय्या पर यहाँ शयन किआ था। यह कुश. उन्हीं के शरीर से मदेन किए हुए हैं

verses.sloka: अथोवाच भरद्वाजो भरतं प्रहसन्निव ।जाने त्वां प्रीतिसंयुक्तं तुष्येस्त्वं येन केनचित् ॥ २.९१.३॥
verses.transliteration: athovāca bharadvājo bharataṁ prahasanniva ।jāne tvāṁ prītisaṁyuktaṁ tuṣyestvaṁ yena kenacit ॥ 2.91.3॥

translations.english: Bharadwaja then said to Bharata with a gentle smile, I know you are full of love and content with whatever is offered you.
translations.hindi: परम भाग्यवान्‌, कुलीन और बुद्धिशाली महाराज दशरथ से उत्पन्न हा, राम ने पुथित्री पर शयन किआ सो यह अत्यन्त अनुचित हुआ है

verses.sloka: सेनायास्तु तवैतस्या: कर्तुमिच्छामि भोजनम् ।मम प्रीतिर्यथारूपा त्वमर्हो मनुजाधिप ॥ २.९१.४॥
verses.transliteration: senāyāstu tavaitasyā: kartumicchāmi bhojanam ।mama prītiryathārūpā tvamarho manujādhipa ॥ 2.91.4॥

translations.english: O Bharata, the best of men, I want to treat your army with food. This will please me and I hope you will act accordingly.
translations.hindi: जो राम, सदा ही राजाओं के सोने योग्य केले की छाल के बने अति कोमल बिछोने से युक्त सेजो पर सोते रहे हैं, वे भला, क्रिस तरह भूमि पर सोए होंगे ?

verses.sloka: किमर्थं चापि निक्षिप्य दूरे बलमिहागत: ।कस्मान्नेहोपयातोसि सबल: पुरुषर्षभ ॥ २.९१.५॥
verses.transliteration: kimarthaṁ cāpi nikṣipya dūre balamihāgata: ।kasmānnehopayātosi sabala: puruṣarṣabha ॥ 2.91.5॥

translations.english: Why did you, O Bharata, the best of men, station your army at a distance before coming here? Could you not approach me along with your army?
translations.hindi: अजिन--शब्देन कटल्याद्यजिनं विवक्षितं । (गो०)२ बलभीषु कूटागारेषु । (गे।०)३ बरास्तरणशालिषु-चित्रकम्त्रलशालिंषु । (गो०) # पाठान्तरे- “सञ्जये ।” ` जिस सातखने राजभवन की चौखण्डी की भूमि सोने और चॉदी की बनी हुई है और जिस पर अच्छे अच्छे रंग बिरंगे ऊनी गलीचे बिछे हुए हें, जिन पर पुष्पों से चित्र । बिचित्र रथनाए की जाती हैं और जो शयनगृह चन्दन और अगर की सुगन्ध से सुवासित है, जो सफेद उजले बादल की तरह दीख पड़ता है, जहाँ पर तोते मैंनाआदि पक्षी बोलते हैं, जो रांजभवनों में सब से श्रेष्ठ है, जहाँ पर आवश्यकतानुसार ठंडक पहुँचाई जा सकती है ( अर्थात्‌ जब चाहो तब कमरे में ढंडक हो जाय ) अथवा जिसमें सदा शीतल और सुगन्धित पबन का सञ्चार हुआ करता है, जिसकी ऊँची दीवाले सोने चाँदी .के काम से खचित होने के कारण भेरुपवत जैसी जान पड़ती हैं-ऐसे' उत्तम शयनागार में सोने बाले राम, जो मधुर गान और उत्तम शुदङ्गादि बाजों के शब्दों से तथा सुन्दर स्त्रियों की पायजेव, | नूपुर आदि गहनां के छुमछुम शब्दों से जगाए जाते थे

verses.sloka: भरत: प्रत्युवाचेदं प्राञ्जलिस्तं तपोधनम् ।ससैन्यो नोपयातो ऽस्मि भगवन् भगवद्भयात् ॥ २.९१.६॥
verses.transliteration: bharata: pratyuvācedaṁ prāñjalistaṁ tapodhanam ।sasainyo nopayāto 'smi bhagavan bhagavadbhayāt ॥ 2.91.6॥

translations.english: With folded palms (in reverence), Bharata said to sage Bharadwaja whose penance was his wealth: I did not approach you with the army for fear of you, O venerable one.

verses.sloka: राज्ञा च भगवन् नित्यं राजपुत्रेण वा सदा ।यत्नत: परिहर्त्तव्या विषयेषु तपस्विन: ॥ २.९१.७॥
verses.transliteration: rājñā ca bhagavan nityaṁ rājaputreṇa vā sadā ।yatnata: pariharttavyā viṣayeṣu tapasvina: ॥ 2.91.7॥

translations.english: O venerable one a king or a prince ought to intentionally avoid those places occupied by ascetics.

verses.sloka: वाजिमुख्या मनुष्याश्च मत्ताश्च वरवारणा: ।प्रच्छाद्य भगवन् भूमिं महतीमनुयान्ति माम् ॥ २.९१.८॥
verses.transliteration: vājimukhyā manuṣyāśca mattāśca varavāraṇā: ।pracchādya bhagavan bhūmiṁ mahatīmanuyānti mām ॥ 2.91.8॥

translations.english: O venerable sage spirited horses, men and mighty rutting elephants follow me covering a wide expanse of land.

verses.sloka: ते वृक्षानुदकं भूमिमाश्रमेषूटजांस्तथा ।न हिंस्युरिति तेनाहमेक एव समागत: ॥ २.९१.९॥
verses.transliteration: te vṛkṣānudakaṁ bhūmimāśrameṣūṭajāṁstathā ।na hiṁsyuriti tenāhameka eva samāgata: ॥ 2.91.9॥

translations.english: Lest the army should damage the huts, trees, land, and defile the water in the ashram, I came here alone.

verses.sloka: आनीयतामित: सेनेत्याज्ञप्त: परमर्षिणा ।ततस्तु चक्रे भरत: सेनाया: समुपागमम् ॥ २.९१.१०॥
verses.transliteration: ānīyatāmita: senetyājñapta: paramarṣiṇā ।tatastu cakre bharata: senāyā: samupāgamam ॥ 2.91.10॥

translations.english: Thus commanded the great ascetic, 'Let the army be brought here'. Accordingly, Bharata ordered the army to come.
translations.hindi: काले--प्रातःकाले | (गो०)# पाठान्तरे- “मा | ? + वे जमीन पर ।सोव, ओर श्रगाल्ल एव वन्य जम्तुओं का भयङ्कर चीत्कार सुन जागे --इस बात पर मुझे न तो विश्वास ही होता है और न यह मुझे सत्य ही जान पड़ती है। क्योंकि इसकी कल्पना मात्र से मुझे भ्रम होने लगता है और स्वप्न सा जान पड़ता है

verses.sloka: अग्निशालां प्रविश्याथ पीत्वाप: परिमृज्य च ।आतिथ्यस्य क्रियाहेतोर्विश्वकर्माणमाह्वयत् ॥ २.९१.११॥
verses.transliteration: agniśālāṁ praviśyātha pītvāpa: parimṛjya ca ।ātithyasya kriyāhetorviśvakarmāṇamāhvayat ॥ 2.91.11॥

translations.english: Then Bharadwaja entered the fire sanctuary, sipped water and washed his hands with water and invoked Visvakarma to provide hospitality.
translations.hindi: निश्चय. ही परमात्मा की इच्छा से बढ, कर कोई देवता नहीं है। नहीं तो महाराज दशरथ के पुत्र हो कर भी, राम जमीन पर कयां सोते

verses.sloka: आह्वये विश्वकर्माणमहं त्वष्टारमेव च ।आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि तत्र मे संविधीयताम् ॥ २.९१.१२॥
verses.transliteration: āhvaye viśvakarmāṇamahaṁ tvaṣṭārameva ca ।ātithyaṁ kartumicchāmi tatra me saṁvidhīyatām ॥ 2.91.12॥

translations.english: I intend to provide hospitality for which I am invoking Visvakarma and Tvastara who builds houses. Let adequate arrangements be made.

verses.sloka: आह्वये लोकपालांस्त्रीन् देवान् शक्रमुखांस्तथा ।आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि तत्र मे संविधीयताम् ॥ २.९१.१३॥
verses.transliteration: āhvaye lokapālāṁstrīn devān śakramukhāṁstathā ।ātithyaṁ kartumicchāmi tatra me saṁvidhīyatām ॥ 2.91.13॥

translations.english: I invoke the three deities, guardians of the four quarters headed by Indra to extend hospitality (to Bharata). Let them make adequate arrangements in this regard.
translations.hindi: हे माता ! देखो मेरे भाई की यह सेज है ! देखो, जैसे जैसे उन्होंने करवटे बदली हैं, वैसे ही वैसे कड़ी भूमि पर विके हुए तृण उनके शरीर से दब दब कर कुचल गए हैं

verses.sloka: प्राक्स्रोतसश्च या नद्य: प्रत्यक्स्रोतस एव च ।पृथिव्यामन्तरिक्षे च समायान्त्वद्य सर्वश: ॥ २.९१.१४॥
verses.transliteration: prāksrotasaśca yā nadya: pratyaksrotasa eva ca ।pṛthivyāmantarikṣe ca samāyāntvadya sarvaśa: ॥ 2.91.14॥

translations.english: Let the rivers flowing towards the east, and the west, flowing on the earth and in the sky, flowing everywhere reach here and now.
translations.hindi: सुके जान्‌ पड़ता है, गहने पहिने हुए सीता साई थी। इसीसे तो जहाँ तहाँ सोने के रोना (दाने) पडे इए देख पड़ते हैं

verses.sloka: अन्या: स्रवन्तु मैरेयं सुरामन्या: सुनिष्ठिताम् ।अपराश्चोदकं शीतमिक्षुकाण्डरसोपमम् ॥ २.९१.१५॥
verses.transliteration: anyā: sravantu maireyaṁ surāmanyā: suniṣṭhitām ।aparāścodakaṁ śītamikṣukāṇḍarasopamam ॥ 2.91.15॥

translations.english: Let some rivers flow with liquor made of datepalms, some with wellprepared wine and some with cool water which tastes like sugarcane juice.
translations.hindi: हे माता ! जान पड़ता है, यहाँ पड़ता है, यहाँ पर सीता की ओढ़नी उल गई थी--क्योंकि यहाँ रेशम के धागे उले हुए हें

verses.sloka: आह्वये देवगन्धर्वान् विश्वावसुहहाहुहून् ।तथैवाप्सरसो देवीर्गन्धर्व्वीश्चापि सर्वश: ॥ २.९१.१६॥
verses.transliteration: āhvaye devagandharvān viśvāvasuhahāhuhūn ।tathaivāpsaraso devīrgandharvvīścāpi sarvaśa: ॥ 2.91.16॥

translations.english: I invoke the gandharvas, Visvavasu, Ha Ha and Hu Hu, and also goddesses like gandharvas (heavenly musicians) and apsaras (nymphs) from all regions.
translations.hindi: मन्ये भतु: सुखा शय्या येन बाला तपस्विनी | सुझुमारी सती दुःखं न बिजानाति मैथिली ॥? ६॥ _ पति की सेज ( केसी ही क्यों न हो अर्थात चाहे वह कोमल हो चाहे कठोर ) स्त्रियों के लिए सदा सुखदायिनी होती है देखो न ! इसीसे इस सुकुमारी तपस्त्रिनी पतित्रता बाला सीता को इस पर सोने से कुछ भी कष्ट न हुआ

verses.sloka: घृताचीमथ विश्वाचीं मिश्रकेशीमलम्बुसाम् ।नागदन्तां च हेमां च हिमामद्रिकृतस्थलाम् ॥ २.९१.१७॥
verses.transliteration: ghṛtācīmatha viśvācīṁ miśrakeśīmalambusām ।nāgadantāṁ ca hemāṁ ca himāmadrikṛtasthalām ॥ 2.91.17॥

translations.english: I summon also Grutachi, Visvachi, Misrakesi, Alambusa, Nagadantha, Hema and Hima whose abode is on the mountain.
translations.hindi: हा ! मैं तो जीते जी ही मर गया । झै बड़ा निदयी हूँ । मेरे ही पीछे तो राम को अपनी खरी के सहित, अनाथ की तरह, ऐसी - शय्या पर साना पड़ा

verses.sloka: शक्रं याश्चोपतिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्माणं याश्च योषित: ।सर्वास्तुम्बुरुणा सार्द्धमाह्वये सपरिच्छदा: ॥ २.९१.१८॥
verses.transliteration: śakraṁ yāścopatiṣṭhanti brahmāṇaṁ yāśca yoṣita: ।sarvāstumburuṇā sārddhamāhvaye saparicchadā: ॥ 2.91.18॥

translations.english: I invoke all the women who attend on Indra and Bramha along with tumbur with all their (musical) instruments.

verses.sloka: वनं कुरुषु यद्दिव्यं वासोभूषणपत्ऺत्रवत् ।दिव्यनारीफलं शश्वत्तत्कौबेरमिहैतु च ॥ २.९१.१९॥
verses.transliteration: vanaṁ kuruṣu yaddivyaṁ vāsobhūṣaṇapatऺtravat ।divyanārīphalaṁ śaśvattatkauberamihaitu ca ॥ 2.91.19॥

translations.english: Let Kubera's divine forest situated in the land of Kurus, where leaves serve as raiment and ornaments and celestial women as its fruits come here.

verses.sloka: इह मे भगवान् सोमो विधत्तामन्नमुत्तमम् ।भक्ष्यं भोज्यं च चोष्यं च लेह्यं च विविधं बहु ॥ २.९१.२०॥
verses.transliteration: iha me bhagavān somo vidhattāmannamuttamam ।bhakṣyaṁ bhojyaṁ ca coṣyaṁ ca lehyaṁ ca vividhaṁ bahu ॥ 2.91.20॥

translations.english: Let the blessed Moon furnish me with excellent food of every kind -- solid, liquid, soft and those which are to be sucked and licked in great variety and quantity.
translations.hindi: इस समय तो झुम लक्षणों वाले लक्ष्मण जी ही बन्य हैं ओर उन्हीं को बड़ भागी समझना;चाहिए कि, जो ऐसे बुरे समय में भी अपने आई राम का साथ दे रहे हं

verses.sloka: विचित्राणि च माल्यानि पादपप्रच्युतानि च ।सुरादीनि च पेयानि मांसानि विविधानि च ॥ २.९१.२१॥
verses.transliteration: vicitrāṇi ca mālyāni pādapapracyutāni ca ।surādīni ca peyāni māṁsāni vividhāni ca ॥ 2.91.21॥

translations.english: Let her furnish me with manycoloured garlands of fresh flowers from trees, wines and other drinks and meat of different kinds.
translations.hindi: और वैदेही जानकी का भी जन्म सफल है, जो अपने पति के साथ वन में गई । हम लोग राम से केवल रहित ही नहीं हैं, किन्तु हमें इस बात का भो सन्देह दै कि, राम हम लोगों की सेवा अङ्गकीर करें या न करें

verses.sloka: एवं समाधिना युक्तस्तेजसा ऽप्रतिमेन च ।शीक्षास्वरसमायुक्तं तपसा चाब्रवीन्मुनि: ॥ २.९१.२२॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ samādhinā yuktastejasā 'pratimena ca ।śīkṣāsvarasamāyuktaṁ tapasā cābravīnmuni: ॥ 2.91.22॥

translations.english: The valiant ascetic of incomparable lustre and power of penance in profound meditation said this in an accent in conformity with Vedic instruction.
translations.hindi: राजा जनक की बेटी और महाराज दशरथ की पतोहू, जे! अति सुन्दरी है और जिस पर महाराज दशरथ की बड़ी कृपा थी, हाय ! जमीन पर सोती हे'!!

verses.sloka: मनसा ध्यायतस्तस्य प्राङ्मुखस्य कृताञ्जले: ।आजग्मुस्तानि सर्वाणि दैवतानि पृथक्पृथक् ॥ २.९१.२३॥
verses.transliteration: manasā dhyāyatastasya prāṅmukhasya kṛtāñjale: ।ājagmustāni sarvāṇi daivatāni pṛthakpṛthak ॥ 2.91.23॥

translations.english: As Bharadwaja with folded palms was thus meditating with his face turned eastward, all the deities appeared there one by one.
translations.hindi: राम वनवास कर रहे हैं तो क्या हुआ, यह प्रथिवी नन्दी के भुजबल से रक्षित होने के कारण, दूसरा इसे लेने की अपने मन में कल्पना भी नहीं कर सकता

verses.sloka: मलयं दर्दुरं चैव तत: स्वेदनुदऽ ऽनिल: ।उपस्पृश्य ववौ युक्त्या सुप्रियात्मा सुख: शिव: ॥ २.९१.२४॥
verses.transliteration: malayaṁ darduraṁ caiva tata: svedanuda' 'nila: ।upaspṛśya vavau yuktyā supriyātmā sukha: śiva: ॥ 2.91.24॥

translations.english: Meanwhile, soft auspicious and pleasant breeze passing over Malaya and Dardura mountains, comforting and cooling the sweat, began to blow.

verses.sloka: ततोभ्यवर्तन्त घना दिव्या: कुसुमवृष्टय: ।दिव्यदुन्दुभिघोषश्च दिक्षु सर्वासु शुश्रुवे ॥ २.९१.२५॥
verses.transliteration: tatobhyavartanta ghanā divyā: kusumavṛṣṭaya: ।divyadundubhighoṣaśca dikṣu sarvāsu śuśruve ॥ 2.91.25॥

translations.english: Then divine clouds rolled in and showered celestial flowers. The sounds of heavenly gongs could be heard in every direction.

verses.sloka: प्रववुश्चोत्तमा वाताननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणा: ।प्रजगुर्देवगन्धर्वा वीणा: प्रमुमुचु: स्वरान् ॥ २.९१.२६॥
verses.transliteration: pravavuścottamā vātānanṛtuścāpsarogaṇā: ।prajagurdevagandharvā vīṇā: pramumucu: svarān ॥ 2.91.26॥

translations.english: Gentle breeze began to blow. Troops of apsaras danced. Gandharvas and gods sang and the lyres rang.
translations.hindi: श्रपि--संभावनायामपिशब्दः | (गो०) [GT ब्राह्मण लोग अयोध्या में राम का राज्याभिषेक करेंगे । देवताश्रों से मैं तो यही प्रार्थना करता हूँ कि वे मेरा मनोरथ पूरा कर

verses.sloka: स शब्दो द्यां च भूमिं च प्राणिनां श्रवणानि च ।विवेशोऺच्चारित: श्लक्ष्ण: समो लयगुणान्वित: ॥ २.९१.२७॥
verses.transliteration: sa śabdo dyāṁ ca bhūmiṁ ca prāṇināṁ śravaṇāni ca ।viveśoऺccārita: ślakṣṇa: samo layaguṇānvita: ॥ 2.91.27॥

translations.english: That soft, melodious, rhythmic and wellmodulated sound entered the heaven and earth as well as the ears of all living beings.
translations.hindi: राम को वन से लोटा कर उनके वदले सैं वन में बसूँगा-- क्योकि बनवास की जो अवधि अभी शेष है, उसे तै पूरी करू गा जिससे बड़े भाई की चौदह वर्ष वनवास करने की प्रतिज्ञा मिथ्या न होने पावे

verses.sloka: तस्मिन्नुपरते शब्दे दिव्ये श्रोतृ(त्र)सुखे नृणाम् ।ददर्श भारतं सैन्यं विधानं विश्वकर्मण: ॥ २.९१.२८॥
verses.transliteration: tasminnuparate śabde divye śrotṛ(tra)sukhe nṛṇām ।dadarśa bhārataṁ sainyaṁ vidhānaṁ viśvakarmaṇa: ॥ 2.91.28॥

translations.english: When the celestial sounds pleasing to the ears of men had subsided, the army of Bharata beheld the wonderful creations of Visvakarma.

verses.sloka: बभूव हि समा भूमि: समन्तात्पञ्चयोजना ।शाद्वलैर्बहुभिश्छन्ना नीलवैडूर्य्यसन्निभै: ॥ २.९१.२९॥
verses.transliteration: babhūva hi samā bhūmi: samantātpañcayojanā ।śādvalairbahubhiśchannā nīlavaiḍūryyasannibhai: ॥ 2.91.29॥

translations.english: The ground was levelled on every side for five yojanas and covered with several grass lawns resembling lapis lazuli (blue sapphire) and cat's eye.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् बिल्वा: कपित्थाश्च पनसा बीजपूरका: ।आमलक्यो बभूवुश्च चूताश्च फलभूषणा: ॥ २.९१.३०॥
verses.transliteration: tasmin bilvā: kapitthāśca panasā bījapūrakā: ।āmalakyo babhūvuśca cūtāśca phalabhūṣaṇā: ॥ 2.91.30॥

translations.english: There the best of fruitbearing trees like bilva trees, woodapple trees, citrons, emblic myrobalan trees and mango trees laden with fruits sprang up.
translations.hindi: पर मुभे विश्वास है कि राम भक्तवत्सल हें, अतः वे अपने दास की उपेत्ता कभी न करेंगे

verses.sloka: उत्तरेभ्य: कुरुभ्यश्च वनं दिव्योपभोगवत् ।आजगाम नदी दिव्या तीजैर्बहुभिर्वृता ॥ २.९१.३१॥
verses.transliteration: uttarebhya: kurubhyaśca vanaṁ divyopabhogavat ।ājagāma nadī divyā tījairbahubhirvṛtā ॥ 2.91.31॥

translations.english: From the forests of the northern Kuru kingdom, with all delights of heaven, a divine river with innumerable trees that grow on river banks came into existence.

verses.sloka: चतु:शालानि शुभ्राणि शालाश्च गजवाजिनाम् ।हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधास्तोरणानि शुभानि च ॥ २.९१.३२॥
verses.transliteration: catu:śālāni śubhrāṇi śālāśca gajavājinām ।harmyaprāsādasambādhāstoraṇāni śubhāni ca ॥ 2.91.32॥

translations.english: Bright quadrangles, stables for elephants and horses, auspicious arch ways for palaces and mansions sprang up.

verses.sloka: सितमेघनिभं चापि राजवेश्मसु तोरणम् ।दिव्यमाल्यकृताकारं दिव्यगन्धसमुक्षितम् ॥ २.९१.३३॥
verses.transliteration: sitameghanibhaṁ cāpi rājaveśmasu toraṇam ।divyamālyakṛtākāraṁ divyagandhasamukṣitam ॥ 2.91.33॥

translations.english: An auspicious royal palace with splendid archs resembling white clouds sprang up. It was sprinkled with celestial perfumes and adorned with beautiful garlands. That royal palace forming a quadrangle was furnished with couches, seats and carriages and furnished with celestial drinks of every kind, delicious food and splendid garments. It was stocked with food of every variety in clean and spotless vessels. Seats for every one and magnificent couches covered with excellent bedstead were arranged.

verses.sloka: चतुरश्रमसम्बाधं शयनासनयानवत् ।दिव्यै: सर्वरसैर्युक्तं दिव्यभोजनवस्त्रवत् ।उपकल्पितसर्वान्नं धौतनिर्मलभाजनम् ॥ २.९१.३४॥
verses.transliteration: caturaśramasambādhaṁ śayanāsanayānavat ।divyai: sarvarasairyuktaṁ divyabhojanavastravat ।upakalpitasarvānnaṁ dhautanirmalabhājanam ॥ 2.91.34॥

translations.english: An auspicious royal palace with splendid archs resembling white clouds sprang up. It was sprinkled with celestial perfumes and adorned with beautiful garlands. That royal palace forming a quadrangle was furnished with couches, seats and carriages and furnished with celestial drinks of every kind, delicious food and splendid garments. It was stocked with food of every variety in clean and spotless vessels. Seats for every one and magnificent couches covered with excellent bedstead were arranged.

verses.sloka: क्लृप्तसर्वासनं श्रीमत् स्वास्तीर्णशयनोत्तमम् ।प्रविवेश महाबाहुरनुज्ञातो महर्षिणा ।वेश्म तद्रत्नसम्पूर्णं भरत: केकयीसुत: ॥ २.९१.३५॥
verses.transliteration: klṛptasarvāsanaṁ śrīmat svāstīrṇaśayanottamam ।praviveśa mahābāhuranujñāto maharṣiṇā ।veśma tadratnasampūrṇaṁ bharata: kekayīsuta: ॥ 2.91.35॥

translations.english: An auspicious royal palace with splendid archs resembling white clouds sprang up. It was sprinkled with celestial perfumes and adorned with beautiful garlands. That royal palace forming a quadrangle was furnished with couches, seats and carriages and furnished with celestial drinks of every kind, delicious food and splendid garments. It was stocked with food of every variety in clean and spotless vessels. Seats for every one and magnificent couches covered with excellent bedstead were arranged.

verses.sloka: अनुजग्मुश्च तं सर्वे मन्त्रिण: सपुरोहिता: ।बभूवुश्च मुदा युक्ता दृष्ट्वा तं वेश्मसंविधिम् ॥ २.९१.३६॥
verses.transliteration: anujagmuśca taṁ sarve mantriṇa: sapurohitā: ।babhūvuśca mudā yuktā dṛṣṭvā taṁ veśmasaṁvidhim ॥ 2.91.36॥

translations.english: Longarmed Bharata, son of Kaikeyi entered that palace full of jewels with the permission of the great sage.

verses.sloka: तत्र राजासनं दिव्यं व्यजनं छत्रमेव च ।भरतो मन्त्रिभि: सार्द्धमभ्यवर्त्तत राजवत् ॥ २.९१.३७॥
verses.transliteration: tatra rājāsanaṁ divyaṁ vyajanaṁ chatrameva ca ।bharato mantribhi: sārddhamabhyavarttata rājavat ॥ 2.91.37॥

translations.english: All the ministers, priests followed him and were glad to see the arrangement in that mansion.

verses.sloka: आसनं पूजयामास रामायाभिप्रणम्य च ।वालव्यजनमादाय न्यषीदत् सचिवासने ॥ २.९१.३८॥
verses.transliteration: āsanaṁ pūjayāmāsa rāmāyābhipraṇamya ca ।vālavyajanamādāya nyaṣīdat sacivāsane ॥ 2.91.38॥

translations.english: There where stood an exquisite throne, a fan and a parasol Bharata stayed in the company of ministers.

verses.sloka: आनुपूर्व्यानिषेदुश्च सर्वे मन्त्रिपुरोहिता: ।तत: सेनापति: पश्चात् प्रशास्ता च निषेदतु: ॥ २.९१.३९॥
verses.transliteration: ānupūrvyāniṣeduśca sarve mantripurohitā: ।tata: senāpati: paścāt praśāstā ca niṣedatu: ॥ 2.91.39॥

translations.english: He bowed in reverence and worshipped the throne (as though Rama were seated there). Taking hold of a fan made of yak's tail he sat in a minister's seat.

verses.sloka: ततस्तत्र मुहूर्त्तेन नद्य: पायसकर्दमा: ।उपातिष्ठन्त भरतं भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ॥ २.९१.४०॥
verses.transliteration: tatastatra muhūrttena nadya: pāyasakardamā: ।upātiṣṭhanta bharataṁ bharadvājasya śāsanāt ॥ 2.91.40॥

translations.english: First the ministers and priests took their respective seats in accordance with their rank, and then the army chief and finally the supervisor of the camp.

verses.sloka: तासामुभयत:कूलं पाण्डुमृत्तिकलेपना: ।रम्याश्चावसथा दिव्या ब्रह्मणस्तु प्रसादजा: ॥ २.९१.४१॥
verses.transliteration: tāsāmubhayata:kūlaṁ pāṇḍumṛttikalepanā: ।ramyāścāvasathā divyā brahmaṇastu prasādajā: ॥ 2.91.41॥

translations.english: Rivers filled with payasam (rice cooked in milk and sugar) in the shape of mud flowed towards Bharata at the command of Bharadwaja.

verses.sloka: तेनैव च मुहूर्त्तेन दिव्याभरणभूषिता: ।आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा ब्रह्मणा प्रहिता: स्त्रिय: ॥ २.९१.४२॥
verses.transliteration: tenaiva ca muhūrttena divyābharaṇabhūṣitā: ।āgurviṁśatisāhasrā brahmaṇā prahitā: striya: ॥ 2.91.42॥

translations.english: On both the banks of those rivers, charming, celestial houses plastered with white clay appeared by the grace of Brahma.

verses.sloka: सुवर्णमणिमुक्तेन प्रवालेन च शोभिता: ।आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा: कुबेरप्रहिता: स्त्रिय: ॥ २.९१.४३॥
verses.transliteration: suvarṇamaṇimuktena pravālena ca śobhitā: ।āgurviṁśatisāhasrā: kuberaprahitā: striya: ॥ 2.91.43॥

translations.english: At that very moment twenty thousand women adorned with beautiful ornaments sent by Brahma presented themselves.

verses.sloka: याभिर्गृहीतपुरुष: सोन्माद इव लक्ष्यते ।आगुर्विंशतिसाहस्रा नन्दनादप्सरोगणा: ॥ २.९१.४४॥
verses.transliteration: yābhirgṛhītapuruṣa: sonmāda iva lakṣyate ।āgurviṁśatisāhasrā nandanādapsarogaṇā: ॥ 2.91.44॥

translations.english: Twenty thousand women adorned with gold, gems and corals sent by Kubera came.

verses.sloka: नारदस्तुम्बुरुर्गोप: प्रवरा: सूर्य्यवर्चस: ।एते गन्धर्वराजानो भरतस्याग्रतो जगु: ॥ २.९१.४५॥
verses.transliteration: nāradastumbururgopa: pravarā: sūryyavarcasa: ।ete gandharvarājāno bharatasyāgrato jagu: ॥ 2.91.45॥

translations.english: Troops of twenty thousand apsaras by whom any man when taken hold of in their arms could be intoxicated with intense passion, came from Nandana gardens.

verses.sloka: अलम्बुसा मिश्रकेशी पुण्डरीकाथ वामना ।उपानृत्यंस्तु भरत भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ॥ २.९१.४६॥
verses.transliteration: alambusā miśrakeśī puṇḍarīkātha vāmanā ।upānṛtyaṁstu bharata bharadvājasya śāsanāt ॥ 2.91.46॥

translations.english: There along with Narada, Tumburu and Gopa, distinguished kings of the gandharvas, looking bright like the Sun, began to sing in the presence of Bharata.

verses.sloka: यानि माल्यानि देवेषु यानि चैत्ररथे वने ।प्रयागे तान्यदृश्यन्त भरद्वाजस्य तेजसा ॥ २.९१.४७॥
verses.transliteration: yāni mālyāni deveṣu yāni caitrarathe vane ।prayāge tānyadṛśyanta bharadvājasya tejasā ॥ 2.91.47॥

translations.english: Thereafter, the apsaras, Alambusa, Misrakesi, Pundarika and Vamana danced near Bharata at the command of Bharadwaja.

verses.sloka: बिल्वा मार्दङ्गिका आसन् शम्याग्राहा विभीतका: ।अश्वत्थानर्त्तकाश्चासन् भरद्वाजस्य शासनात् ॥ २.९१.४८॥
verses.transliteration: bilvā mārdaṅgikā āsan śamyāgrāhā vibhītakā: ।aśvatthānarttakāścāsan bharadvājasya śāsanāt ॥ 2.91.48॥

translations.english: The garlands of the gods available in Chitraratha's (Kubera's) garden could not match those obtained under the orders of Bharadwaja.

verses.sloka: तत: सरलतालाश्च तिलका नक्तमालका: ।प्रहृष्टास्तत्र सम्पेतु: कुब्जा भूत्वाथ वामना: ॥ २.९१.४९॥
verses.transliteration: tata: saralatālāśca tilakā naktamālakā: ।prahṛṣṭāstatra sampetu: kubjā bhūtvātha vāmanā: ॥ 2.91.49॥

translations.english: At the command of Bharadwaja, bilva trees acted as drummers, vibhitaka trees as cymbalists and the pipal trees as dancers.

verses.sloka: शिंशुपामलकीजम्ब्वो याश्चान्या: काननेषु ता: ।मालती मल्लिका जातिर्याश्चान्या: कानने लता: ॥ २.९१.५०॥
verses.transliteration: śiṁśupāmalakījambvo yāścānyā: kānaneṣu tā: ।mālatī mallikā jātiryāścānyā: kānane latā: ॥ 2.91.50॥

translations.english: Thereafter pine, palmyra, tilaka, and naktamala trees were transformed into hunchbacks and dwarfs and moved about in great delight.

verses.sloka: प्रमदाविग्रहं कृत्वा भरद्वाजाश्रमे ऽवदन् ।सुरा: सुरापा: पिबत पायसं च बुभुक्षिता: ।मांसानि च सुमेध्यानि भक्ष्यन्तां यावदिच्छथ ॥ २.९१.५१॥
verses.transliteration: pramadāvigrahaṁ kṛtvā bharadvājāśrame 'vadan ।surā: surāpā: pibata pāyasaṁ ca bubhukṣitā: ।māṁsāni ca sumedhyāni bhakṣyantāṁ yāvadicchatha ॥ 2.91.51॥

translations.english: Asohka, emblic myrobalan and all other trees found in the forest malati, mallika and jati creepers assumed the form of women, came over to the hermitage of Bharadwaja and said:

verses.sloka: उच्छाद्य स्नापयन्ति स्म नदीतीरेषु वल्गुषु ।अप्येकमेकं पुरुषं प्रमदा: सप्त चाष्ट च ॥ २.९१.५२॥
verses.transliteration: ucchādya snāpayanti sma nadītīreṣu valguṣu ।apyekamekaṁ puruṣaṁ pramadā: sapta cāṣṭa ca ॥ 2.91.52॥

translations.english: 'O wine drinkers, drink as much as you can those who are hungry partake payasam and sacred meat'.

verses.sloka: संवाहन्त्य: समापेतुर्नार्यो रुचिरलोचना: ।परिमृज्य तथान्योन्यं पाययन्ति वराङ्गना: ॥ २.९१.५३॥
verses.transliteration: saṁvāhantya: samāpeturnāryo ruciralocanā: ।parimṛjya tathānyonyaṁ pāyayanti varāṅganā: ॥ 2.91.53॥

translations.english: 'O wine drinkers, drink as much as you can those who are hungry partake payasam and sacred meat'.

verses.sloka: हयान् गजान् खरानुष्ट्रांस्तथैव सुरभे: सुतान् ।अभोजयन् वाहनपास्तेषां भोज्यं यथाविधि ॥ २.९१.५४॥
verses.transliteration: hayān gajān kharānuṣṭrāṁstathaiva surabhe: sutān ।abhojayan vāhanapāsteṣāṁ bhojyaṁ yathāvidhi ॥ 2.91.54॥

translations.english: Every single warrior was attended by seven or eight women who applied oil and massaged his body and bathed him on the lovely banks of the river.

verses.sloka: इक्षूंश्च मधुलाजांश्च भोजयन्ति स्म वाहनान् ।इक्ष्वाकुवरयोधानां चोदयन्तो महाबला: ॥ २.९१.५५॥
verses.transliteration: ikṣūṁśca madhulājāṁśca bhojayanti sma vāhanān ।ikṣvākuvarayodhānāṁ codayanto mahābalā: ॥ 2.91.55॥

translations.english: Some women with beautiful eyes quickly approached them for massaging. The best of ladies wiped their bodies dry and gave each other wine to drink.

verses.sloka: नाश्वबन्धो ऽश्वमाजानान्न गजं कुञ्जरग्रह: ।मत्तप्रमत्तमुदिता नमू: सा तत्र सम्बभौ ॥ २.९१.५६॥
verses.transliteration: nāśvabandho 'śvamājānānna gajaṁ kuñjaragraha: ।mattapramattamuditā namū: sā tatra sambabhau ॥ 2.91.56॥

translations.english: The attendants of draughtanimals fed the horses, elephants, donkeys, camels and oxen their appropriate food.

verses.sloka: तर्पिता: सर्वकामैस्ते रक्तचन्दनरूषिता: ।अप्सरोगणसंयुक्ता: सैन्या वाचमुदैरयन् ॥ २.९१.५७॥
verses.transliteration: tarpitā: sarvakāmaiste raktacandanarūṣitā: ।apsarogaṇasaṁyuktā: sainyā vācamudairayan ॥ 2.91.57॥

translations.english: The draughtaimals of the illustrious warriors of Ikshvaku kings were urged by the highly energetic attendants to eat more and more of parched grain mixed with sugarcane and honey.

verses.sloka: नैवायोध्यां गमिष्यामो न गमिष्याम दण्डकान् ।कुशलं भरतस्यास्तु रामस्यास्तु तथा सुखम् ॥ २.९१.५८॥
verses.transliteration: naivāyodhyāṁ gamiṣyāmo na gamiṣyāma daṇḍakān ।kuśalaṁ bharatasyāstu rāmasyāstu tathā sukham ॥ 2.91.58॥

translations.english: The horserider no longer recognised the horse or the mahout the elephant and the whole army was inebriated with drinking and pleasure.

verses.sloka: इति पादातयोधाश्च हस्त्यश्वारोह बन्धका: ।अनाथास्तं विधिं लब्ध्वा वाचमेतामुदैरयन् ॥ २.९१.५९॥
verses.transliteration: iti pādātayodhāśca hastyaśvāroha bandhakā: ।anāthāstaṁ vidhiṁ labdhvā vācametāmudairayan ॥ 2.91.59॥

translations.english: All the armymen with their desires gratified and anointing their bodies with red sandal paste surrounded by apsaras exclaimed.

verses.sloka: सम्प्रहृष्टा विनेदुस्ते नरास्तत्र सहस्रश: ।भरतस्यानुयातार: स्वर्गोयमिति चाब्रुवन् ॥ २.९१.६०॥
verses.transliteration: samprahṛṣṭā vineduste narāstatra sahasraśa: ।bharatasyānuyātāra: svargoyamiti cābruvan ॥ 2.91.60॥

translations.english: We will neither return to Ayodhya, nor enter Dandaka (forest). May Bharata and Rama be happy.

verses.sloka: नृत्यन्ति स्म हसन्ति स्म गायन्ति स्म च सैनिका: ।समन्तात् परिधावन्ति माल्योपेता: सहस्रश: ॥ २.९१.६१॥
verses.transliteration: nṛtyanti sma hasanti sma gāyanti sma ca sainikā: ।samantāt paridhāvanti mālyopetā: sahasraśa: ॥ 2.91.61॥

translations.english: Having enjoyed the hospitality of Bharadwaja the foot soldiers, horse and elephant riders made utterances ignoring their leaders.

verses.sloka: ततो भुक्तवतां तेषां तदन्नममृतोपमम् ।दिव्यानुद्वीक्ष्य भक्ष्यांस्तानभवद्भक्षणे मति: ॥ २.९१.६२॥
verses.transliteration: tato bhuktavatāṁ teṣāṁ tadannamamṛtopamam ।divyānudvīkṣya bhakṣyāṁstānabhavadbhakṣaṇe mati: ॥ 2.91.62॥

translations.english: The exceedingly delighted soldiers of Bharata's retinue in their thousands cried out with excitement This is the very heaven.

verses.sloka: प्रेष्याश्चेष्ट्यश्च वध्वश्च बलस्थाश्च सहस्रश: ।बभूवुस्ऺते भृशं दृप्ता: सर्वे चाहतवासस: ॥ २.९१.६३॥
verses.transliteration: preṣyāśceṣṭyaśca vadhvaśca balasthāśca sahasraśa: ।babhūvusऺte bhṛśaṁ dṛptā: sarve cāhatavāsasa: ॥ 2.91.63॥

translations.english: Those thousands of soldiers wearing flower garlands ran about dancing, singing, and laughing.

verses.sloka: कुञ्जराश्च खरोष्ट्राश्च गोश्वाश्च मृगपक्षिण: ।बभूवु: सुभृतास्तत्र नान्यो ह्यन्यमकल्पयत् ॥ २.९१.६४॥
verses.transliteration: kuñjarāśca kharoṣṭrāśca gośvāśca mṛgapakṣiṇa: ।babhūvu: subhṛtāstatra nānyo hyanyamakalpayat ॥ 2.91.64॥

translations.english: Glancing at the ambrosial food, a desire arose in the minds of those soldiers to eat once again although they had already partaken it.

verses.sloka: नाशुक्लवासास्तत्रासीत् क्षुधितो मलिनो ऽपि वा ।रजसा ध्वस्तकेशो वा नर: कश्चिददृश्यत ॥ २.९१.६५॥
verses.transliteration: nāśuklavāsāstatrāsīt kṣudhito malino 'pi vā ।rajasā dhvastakeśo vā nara: kaścidadṛśyata ॥ 2.91.65॥

translations.english: Messengers, maidservants, female attendants, and soldiers -- all of them in their thousands dressed in fresh garments felt exceedingly proud of themselves.

verses.sloka: आजैश्चापि च वाराहैर्निष्ठानवरसञ्चयै: ।फलनिर्यूहसंसिद्धै: सूपैर्गन्धरसान्वितै: ॥ २.९१.६६॥
verses.transliteration: ājaiścāpi ca vārāhairniṣṭhānavarasañcayai: ।phalaniryūhasaṁsiddhai: sūpairgandharasānvitai: ॥ 2.91.66॥

translations.english: There the elephants, donkeys and camels, cows and horses and also beasts and birds were wellnourished. No one troubled the other.

verses.sloka: पुष्पध्वजवती: पूर्णा: शुक्लस्यान्नस्य चाभित: ।ददृशुर्विस्मितास्तत्र नरा लौही: सहस्रश: ॥ २.९१.६७॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpadhvajavatī: pūrṇā: śuklasyānnasya cābhita: ।dadṛśurvismitāstatra narā lauhī: sahasraśa: ॥ 2.91.67॥

translations.english: In that army there was none who could be seen without wearing garments of sparkling white, who was hungry or dirty or with decayed hair.

verses.sloka: बभूवुर्वनपार्श्वेषु कूपा: पायसकर्दमा: ।ताश्च कामदुघा गावो द्रुमाश्चासन् मधुस्रुत: ॥ २.९१.६८॥
verses.transliteration: babhūvurvanapārśveṣu kūpā: pāyasakardamā: ।tāśca kāmadughā gāvo drumāścāsan madhusruta: ॥ 2.91.68॥

translations.english: There the soldiers beheld in amazement thousands of iron containers decked with flags and flowers and filled with white rice, mutton, pork, choicest condiments, fruit juice, fragrant and tasty soup.

verses.sloka: वाप्यो मैरेयपूर्णाश्च मृष्टमांसचयैर्वृता: ।प्रतप्तपिठरैश्चापि मार्गमायूरकौक्कुटै: ॥ २.९१.६९॥
verses.transliteration: vāpyo maireyapūrṇāśca mṛṣṭamāṁsacayairvṛtā: ।prataptapiṭharaiścāpi mārgamāyūrakaukkuṭai: ॥ 2.91.69॥

translations.english: There the soldiers beheld in amazement thousands of iron containers decked with flags and flowers and filled with white rice, mutton, pork, choicest condiments, fruit juice, fragrant and tasty soup.

verses.sloka: पात्रीणां च सहस्राणि स्थालीनां नियुतानि च ।न्यर्बुदानि च पात्राणि शातकुम्भमयानि च ॥ २.९१.७०॥
verses.transliteration: pātrīṇāṁ ca sahasrāṇi sthālīnāṁ niyutāni ca ।nyarbudāni ca pātrāṇi śātakumbhamayāni ca ॥ 2.91.70॥

translations.english: Along the edge of the forest, wells were filled with thick payasam. There were wishfulfilling cows and honeydripping trees.

verses.sloka: स्थाल्य: कुम्भ्य: करम्भ्यश्च दधिपूर्णा: सुसंस्कृता: ।यौवनस्थस्य गौरस्य कपित्थस्य सुगन्धिन: ॥ २.९१.७१॥
verses.transliteration: sthālya: kumbhya: karambhyaśca dadhipūrṇā: susaṁskṛtā: ।yauvanasthasya gaurasya kapitthasya sugandhina: ॥ 2.91.71॥

translations.english: The wells were found filled with datepalm liquor and surrounded by pots of well cooked meat of peacocks, chicken and other animals.

verses.sloka: ह्रदा: पूर्णा रसालस्य दघ्न: श्वेतस्य चापरे ।बभूवु: पायसस्यान्ये शर्करायाश्च सञ्चया: ॥ २.९१.७२॥
verses.transliteration: hradā: pūrṇā rasālasya daghna: śvetasya cāpare ।babhūvu: pāyasasyānye śarkarāyāśca sañcayā: ॥ 2.91.72॥

translations.english: There were thousands of pots, lakhs of plates, crores of vessels -- all made of gold and filled with wellgarnished food. Curd was kept in earthern pots like jugs and jars and pots with a wide mouth. Tanks were formed, some filled with white curd of good flavour and of the colour of woodapple, some with white curd blended with spices and some with payasam and heaps of barely powder mixed with sugar.

verses.sloka: कल्कांश्चूर्णकषायांश्च स्नानानि विविधानि च ।ददृशुर्भाजनस्थानि तीर्थेषु सरितां नरा: ॥ २.९१.७३॥
verses.transliteration: kalkāṁścūrṇakaṣāyāṁśca snānāni vividhāni ca ।dadṛśurbhājanasthāni tīrtheṣu saritāṁ narā: ॥ 2.91.73॥

translations.english: There were thousands of pots, lakhs of plates, crores of vessels -- all made of gold and filled with wellgarnished food. Curd was kept in earthern pots like jugs and jars and pots with a wide mouth. Tanks were formed, some filled with white curd of good flavour and of the colour of woodapple, some with white curd blended with spices and some with payasam and heaps of barely powder mixed with sugar.

verses.sloka: शुक्लानंशुमतश्चापि दन्तधावनसञ्चयान् ।शुक्लांश्चन्दनकल्कांश्च समुद्गेष्ववतिष्ठत: ॥ २.९१.७४॥
verses.transliteration: śuklānaṁśumataścāpi dantadhāvanasañcayān ।śuklāṁścandanakalkāṁśca samudgeṣvavatiṣṭhata: ॥ 2.91.74॥

translations.english: There were thousands of pots, lakhs of plates, crores of vessels -- all made of gold and filled with wellgarnished food. Curd was kept in earthern pots like jugs and jars and pots with a wide mouth. Tanks were formed, some filled with white curd of good flavour and of the colour of woodapple, some with white curd blended with spices and some with payasam and heaps of barely powder mixed with sugar.

verses.sloka: दर्पणान् परिमृष्टांश्च वाससां चापि सञ्चयान् ।पादुकोपानहश्चैव युग्मानि च सहस्रश: ॥ २.९१.७५॥
verses.transliteration: darpaṇān parimṛṣṭāṁśca vāsasāṁ cāpi sañcayān ।pādukopānahaścaiva yugmāni ca sahasraśa: ॥ 2.91.75॥

translations.english: The soldiers saw on the river banks at landing places levigated powder, fragrant powder and extracts and other bathing requisites of different kinds stored in receptacles.

verses.sloka: आञ्जनी: कङ्कतान् कूर्चान् शस्त्राणि च धनूंषि च ।मर्मत्राणानि चित्राणि शयनान्यासनानि च ॥ २.९१.७६॥
verses.transliteration: āñjanī: kaṅkatān kūrcān śastrāṇi ca dhanūṁṣi ca ।marmatrāṇāni citrāṇi śayanānyāsanāni ca ॥ 2.91.76॥

translations.english: There the soldiers beheld on every side stacks of toothbrushing sticks, white and bristled, white lumps of sandal paste placed in dishes made of leaves, well cleaned mirrors, collection of clothes, several pairs of footwear, collyrium boxes, combs, brushes for cleaning moustaches, weapons, parasoles, bows and shining armour, different kinds of couches, and seats. There were pools of drinking water for donkeys, camels, elephants and horses and excellent landing places filled with flowering lotuses and water lilies. The lakes were of transparent waters resembling the hue of the sky easy and comfortable for swimming. There they saw heaps of soft grass as green as sapphire and kadamva trees for animals to refresh themselves under.

verses.sloka: प्रतिपानह्रदान् पूर्णान् खरोष्ट्रगजवाजिनाम् ।अवगाह्य सुतीर्थांश्च ह्रदान् सोत्पलपुष्करान् ॥ २.९१.७७॥
verses.transliteration: pratipānahradān pūrṇān kharoṣṭragajavājinām ।avagāhya sutīrthāṁśca hradān sotpalapuṣkarān ॥ 2.91.77॥

verses.sloka: आकाशवर्णप्रतिमान् स्वच्छतोयान् सुखप्लवान् ।नीलवैडूर्य्यवर्णांश्च मृदून् यवससञ्चयान् ॥ २.९१.७८॥
verses.transliteration: ākāśavarṇapratimān svacchatoyān sukhaplavān ।nīlavaiḍūryyavarṇāṁśca mṛdūn yavasasañcayān ॥ 2.91.78॥

translations.english: There the soldiers beheld on every side stacks of toothbrushing sticks, white and bristled, white lumps of sandal paste placed in dishes made of leaves, well cleaned mirrors, collection of clothes, several pairs of footwear, collyrium boxes, combs, brushes for cleaning moustaches, weapons, parasoles, bows and shining armour, different kinds of couches, and seats. verses.sloka: निर्वापार्थान् पशूनां ते ददृशुस्तत्र सर्वश: ॥ २.९१.७९॥
verses.transliteration: nirvāpārthān paśūnāṁ te dadṛśustatra sarvaśa: ॥ 2.91.79॥

translations.english: There the soldiers beheld on every side stacks of toothbrushing sticks, white and bristled, white lumps of sandal paste placed in dishes made of leaves, well cleaned mirrors, collection of clothes, several pairs of footwear, collyrium boxes, combs, brushes for cleaning moustaches, weapons, parasoles, bows and shining armour, different kinds of couches, and seats. verses.sloka: व्यस्मयन्त मनुष्यास्ते स्वप्नकल्पं तदद्भुतम् ।दृष्ट्वातिथ्यं कृतं तादृक् भरतस्य महर्षिणा ॥ २.९१.८०॥
verses.transliteration: vyasmayanta manuṣyāste svapnakalpaṁ tadadbhutam ।dṛṣṭvātithyaṁ kṛtaṁ tādṛk bharatasya maharṣiṇā ॥ 2.91.80॥

translations.english: There the soldiers beheld on every side stacks of toothbrushing sticks, white and bristled, white lumps of sandal paste placed in dishes made of leaves, well cleaned mirrors, collection of clothes, several pairs of footwear, collyrium boxes, combs, brushes for cleaning moustaches, weapons, parasoles, bows and shining armour, different kinds of couches, and seats. verses.sloka: इत्येवं रममाणानां देवानामिव नन्दने ।भरद्वाजाश्रमे रम्ये सा रात्रिर्व्यत्यवर्त्तत ॥ २.९१.८१॥
verses.transliteration: ityevaṁ ramamāṇānāṁ devānāmiva nandane ।bharadvājāśrame ramye sā rātrirvyatyavarttata ॥ 2.91.81॥

translations.english: The men were amazed when they beheld the wonderful hospitality extended by maharshi Bharadwaja to Bharata, as if all this happened in a dream world.

verses.sloka: प्रतिजग्मुश्च ता नद्यो गन्धर्वाश्च यथागतम् ।भरद्वाजमनुज्ञाप्य ताश्च सर्वा वराङ्गना: ॥ २.९१.८२॥
verses.transliteration: pratijagmuśca tā nadyo gandharvāśca yathāgatam ।bharadvājamanujñāpya tāśca sarvā varāṅganā: ॥ 2.91.82॥

translations.english: As they were enjoying themselves in Bharadwaja's hermitage like the gods in the garden of Indra the night wore off.

verses.sloka: तथैव मत्ता मदिरोत्कटा नरास्तथैव दिव्यागुरुचन्दनोक्षिता: ।तथैव दिव्या विविधा: स्रगुत्तमा: पृथक् प्रकीर्णा मनुजै: प्रमर्दिता: ॥ २.९१.८३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathaiva mattā madirotkaṭā narāstathaiva divyāgurucandanokṣitā: ।tathaiva divyā vividhā: sraguttamā: pṛthak prakīrṇā manujai: pramarditā: ॥ 2.91.83 ॥

translations.english: Those rivers, the gandharvas and all those lovely women took leave of sage Bharadwaja and returned to where they had come from.
